entities.summary: Count Carl Gustaf Frölich was a Swedish military officer of German descent, Riga Governor in 1700–1706 and infantry general. He was the brother of a Pietist writer and mystic Eva Margareta Frölich (1650–1692) and a colonel Hans Frederik Frölich (1637–1715).

entities.summary: Count Carl Gustaf Frölich was a Swedish military officer of German descent, Riga Governor in 1700–1706 and infantry general. He was the brother of a Pietist writer and mystic Eva Margareta Frölich (1650–1692) and a colonel Hans Frederik Frölich (1637–1715).
